I would like you to implement a module named TopModule with the following
interface. All input and output ports are one bit unless otherwise
specified.

 - input  clk
 - input  enable
 - input  S
 - input  A
 - input  B
 - input  C
 - output Z

The module should implement a circuit for an 8x1 memory, where writing to
the memory is accomplished by shifting-in bits, and reading is "random
access", as in a typical RAM. You will then use the circuit to realize a
3-input logic function. First, create an 8-bit shift register with 8
D-type flip-flops. Label the flip-flop outputs from Q[0]...Q[7]. The
shift register input should be called S, which feeds the input of Q[0]
(MSB is shifted in first). The enable input is synchronous active high
and controls whether to shift. Extend the circuit to have 3 additional
inputs A,B,C and an output Z. The circuit's behaviour should be as
follows: when ABC is 000, Z=Q[0], when ABC is 001, Z=Q[1], and so on.
Your circuit should contain ONLY the 8-bit shift register, and
multiplexers. Assume all sequential logic is triggered on the positive
edge of the clock.

This is one fresh independent VerilogEval v2 spec-to-RTL experiment using GPT-6.1 Sol. Work ONLY in this task directory. Read only problem.txt, policy.txt and the supplied experiment helpers. DO NOT use Skills: do not discover, read, invoke, or apply any SKILL.md or skill resources. Both experiment conditions prohibit all Skills. Official evaluation occurs after your turn; no official feedback or retries are available.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Structural benchmark contract gate, not a functional correctness proof."""
import hashlib
import json
import time
from pathlib import Path

path = Path('contract.json')
data = json.loads(path.read_text())
assert data.get('status') == 'frozen', 'Contract must be frozen'
for field in ('interface', 'semantics', 'numeric', 'verification'):
    assert isinstance(data.get(field), dict) and data[field], f'Missing {field}'
assert isinstance(data.get('specification_ambiguities'), list), 'Missing ambiguity list'
report = {'status': 'passed_structure_only', 'checked_at_unix': time.time(),
          'contract_sha256': hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
Path('contract_gate.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
with Path('contract_gate_history.jsonl').open('a') as stream:
    stream.write(json.dumps(report) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(report))

  \"semantics\": {
    \"state\": \"Eight D flip-flop outputs Q[0] through Q[7], with no reset port or initialization specified.\",
    \"transition\": \"On each positive clock edge, if enable is high, Q[0] receives S and each Q[i] for i=1..7 receives the prior Q[i-1]. Otherwise all bits hold.\",
    \"read\": \"Combinational Z = Q[index], where index is ABC with A most significant and C least significant; no read latency.\",
    \"evidence\": \"Original states S feeds Q[0], synchronous active-high enable, all sequential logic positive-edge triggered, and ABC=000 selects Q[0], ABC=001 selects Q[1], and so on.\",
    \"structure\": \"Only an eight-bit shift register and multiplexers.\"
  },
  \"numeric\": {\"state_width\": 8, \"address_width\": 3, \"address_range\": [0, 7], \"bit_order\": \"Serial MSB first yields first bit in Q[7] after eight enabled edges.\"},
  \"verification\": {\"oracle\": \"Independent per-bit historical state model based on original text\", \"cases\": [\"Uninitialized state before writes\", \"All eight read addresses\", \"Partial fill and propagation of unknown bits\", \"Disabled positive edges\", \"No change on negative edges or S changes\", \"MSB-first full-word loading\", \"Mixed enabled and disabled shifts\"], \"sampling\": \"Check after settling following positive edges and asynchronous address changes\", \"termination\": \"Fatal on mismatch, bounded timeout, PASS only on completion\"},
  \"specification_ambiguities\": [\"No reset or power-up values are specified; RTL leaves flip-flops uninitialized and simulation tests expect unknown bits until written. Inputs with unknown enable or address are not assigned additional behavioral requirements.\"]
}
EOF
python3 validate_contract.py"
